**Bold**

Nuestra compañía fue fundada en Mayo de 2019 por un equipo de personas increíbles y con una experiencia única, el grupo de fundadores está conformado por los creadores de PayU Latam y otras empresas expertas en tecnología financiera. Estamos creando soluciones de pago y de banca para MiPymes, independientes y emprendedores en Colombia. Actualmente contamos con más de 450.000 clientes registrados en nuestra plataforma y hemos recibido más de USD $120 millones de fondos de inversión nacionales y extranjeros, somos una de las startups de más rápido crecimiento en LatAm en el sector fintech. Bold es una fintech que provee una solución de pagos a los microempresarios para recibir pagos con tarjetas débito, crédito y billeteras a través de datáfonos y links de pago. Sin embargo, la visión de Bold es más ambiciosa que ser una empresa de pagos y estamos trabajando para volvernos una plataforma de servicios financieros y tecnológicos para las pequeñas empresas en el país complementando las soluciones de pagos y banca con otros productos de software conexos a toda nuestra propuesta de valor. Nuestra misión en Bold es liberar el potencial de los emprendedores. En Bold creemos firmemente que podemos ayudar a los pequeños emprendedores a desarrollar sus negocios ofreciendo servicios financieros y tecnológicos hechos a su medida, que sean amigables y cercanos. En Bold definimos los siguientes valores como los pilares de nuestra cultura organizacional: Maestría, Pensamiento crítico, Trabajo en equipo, Sentido de urgencia, Somos abiertos y el cliente el centro de lo que hacemos. Para más información acerca de Bold visita nuestro sitio web: https://bold.co

**El Rol:**

El **Design System Manager** define y lidera la estrategia del design system de Bold, para que diseñadores, ingenieros y agentes de AI construyan productos consistentes, accesibles y muy intuitivos a partir de una única fuente de verdad.  
  
Lidera un equipo multidisciplinario de UX, UI e ingeniería. Su reto es que el sistema exista en Figma y en código, sincronizado de punta a punta, que su adopción en la organización sea medible y que sus componentes y reglas sean legibles tanto para personas como para agentes de AI.

**Responsabilidades:**

**Estrategia y visión**

* Definir la visión, el roadmap y las prioridades del design system de Bold, alineados con los objetivos de producto y de negocio.
* Establecer principios, gobernanza y criterios de contribución: qué entra al sistema, quién decide y cómo se versiona.
* Diseñar el sistema para que lo consuman personas y agentes de AI por igual: tokens, componentes y documentación estructurados, semánticos y legibles por máquina.

**Liderazgo del equipo**

* Gestionar y desarrollar al equipo de design system: diseño UX, diseño UI e ingeniería de desarrollo.
* Planificar capacidad, priorizar el backlog y asegurar entregas con calidad y consistencia.
* Coordinar con los equipos de producto, diseño e ingeniería (web y app) como socio, no como área de soporte.

**Librería de componentes**

* Crear y mantener la librería de componentes en diseño (Figma) y en código, con paridad entre ambas.
* Garantizar accesibilidad, rendimiento, responsive y documentación de uso (UI y UX) en cada componente.
* Gestionar tokens de diseño (color, tipografía, espaciado, motion) como base común de ambos mundos.

**Adopción medible**

* Lograr que los diseñadores UX construyan prototipos con los componentes UI del sistema.
* Lograr que los ingenieros front de web y app construyan los productos con el código de los componentes.
* Definir y seguir métricas de adopción (por ejemplo, % de pantallas y productos que usan componentes del DS, cobertura de componentes, desviaciones, tiempo de entrega) y usarlas para priorizar mejoras.
* Dar soporte, formación y comunicación continua para impulsar el uso en toda la organización.

**Flujo de trabajo end to end diseño a código**

* Ser dueño del flujo completo: toda actualización de UI o UX en el DS debe reflejarse en el repositorio de componentes en código.
* Implementar pipelines de versionado, publicación y pruebas (incluidas pruebas visuales y de accesibilidad) que permitan a los productos actualizarse a nuevas versiones de forma automática.
* Gestionar cambios importantes, deprecaciones y comunicación de versiones para no romper los productos.

**¿Qué tenemos para ti?**

‍ ️ Auxilio de salud.

Bono anual por cumplimiento de objetivos empresariales (acciones o dinero).

Contrato a término indefinido.

Salario competitivo.

‍ Trabajo remoto 100%.

Apoyo económico para educación.

Tecnologías y procesos de clase mundial.

️ Días libres adicionales a las vacaciones.

**Experiencia requerida**

* 3 a 6 años o más en product management, ingeniería front-end o design systems, con al menos 2 años liderando equipos.
* Portafolio o casos que muestren resultados medibles de adopción y de impacto en velocidad o consistencia.

**Habilidades técnicas**

* Dominio de Figma: componentes, variables, tokens, variantes y librerías compartidas.
* Conocimiento sólido de front-end: HTML, CSS, TypeScript, React y desarrollo de librerías de componentes (también deseable conocimiento de desarrollo móvil).
* Gestión de tokens y su automatización del diseño al código (por ejemplo, Style Dictionary o Tokens Studio).
* Pipelines de CI/CD, versionado semántico, publicación de paquetes y pruebas (unitarias, visuales y de accesibilidad).
* Documentación de componentes (por ejemplo, Storybook) y accesibilidad (WCAG).
* Comprensión de cómo trabajan los agentes de AI con sistemas de diseño: documentación y metadatos legibles por máquina, MCP, reglas y guías que un agente pueda seguir para generar UI correcta.

**Gestión y liderazgo**

* Liderazgo de equipos multidisciplinarios de diseño e ingeniería, con capacidad de desarrollar y dar feedback.
* Pensamiento estratégico y de producto: tratar el design system como un producto interno con usuarios, roadmap y métricas.
* Definición y seguimiento de mé

Position: UI/UX Designer  
Type: Full-Time  
Location: Hybrid (Bogota or Barranquilla)  
Employment Type: Full-time, Contractor

### **Who We Are**

SellCord is a leading agency specializing in launching and scaling brands exclusively on Walmart Marketplace. As Walmart-approved partners, we help businesses grow by optimizing their presence on the platform and driving sustainable success.

### **About the Role**

We are seeking a creative, user-focused UI/UX Designer to join SellCord's Marketing team. This role designs the websites, landing pages, and digital experiences that turn Walmart Marketplace sellers into SellCord clients, and keeps our visual identity consistent across every touchpoint.

The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with a research-driven approach to user experience. They are comfortable owning projects from wireframe to developer handoff and thrive in a fast-moving, remote team.

### **Roles and Responsibilities**

* Design and optimize SellCord's website, landing pages, and lead-generation flows with a focus on conversion.
* Create wireframes, user flows, and interactive prototypes in Figma for new pages and campaigns.
* Build and maintain a scalable design system and component library aligned with SellCord's brand.
* Conduct user research and usability testing, then translate insights into clear design improvements.
* Ensure all designs are responsive, mobile-first, and meet accessibility best practices.
* Prepare clean specs and assets for developer handoff, and support builds in Webflow or similar tools.
* Partner with marketing, sales, and leadership to design campaign assets, sales collateral, and event materials.
* Track page performance and iterate on designs based on data and stakeholder feedback.

### **Skills and Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience as a UI/UX, product, or web designer, ideally at an agency or B2B company.
* Expert-level proficiency in Figma, including auto-layout, components, and design systems.
* A strong portfolio showing web, landing-page, and conversion-focused design work.
* Experience with UX research methods, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing.
* Strong English communication skills (verbal and written) are required.
* Familiarity with Webflow or other no-code builders and basic HTML/CSS preferred.
* Ability to take feedback well, iterate quickly, and explain design decisions in business terms.
* Self-motivated and organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects in a remote setting.

### **Why It’s Awesome to Join SellCord**

* Be part of a fast-growing, innovation-driven company.
* Work with a global team committed to operational excellence.
* Competitive compensation package with vacation days, sick leave, and paid holidays.
* Opportunity to shape the look and experience of a growing brand from the ground up.

 About The Role
 As a Senior Creative Designer, you'll play a key role in developing compelling visual content that brings brand identity to life while meeting client goals across digital, print, and AI-driven platforms. We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, collaborative, detail-oriented, and passionate about design innovation and emerging creative technologies.
 Responsibilities
 Develop and refine brand-aligned visual concepts, ensuring cohesion across all touchpoints, including digital marketing assets, print collateral, and interfaces for AI-driven platforms.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Product, Content) to translate creative briefs into impactful visual assets and engaging user experiences.
 Lead design execution across multiple simultaneous projects, ensuring all deliverables meet high standards of quality, accuracy, and brand consistency while adhering to project timelines.
 Conduct trend research and ideation to infuse daily work with fresh design perspectives, modern web patterns, and emerging technologies.
 Build and maintain organized, scalable design assets and components using Figma as the primary design tool.
 Engage actively in critique and feedback sessions, iterating designs quickly based on stakeholder input and fostering open, constructive communication.
 Optimize visual assets across digital channels, ensuring high performance, responsive layouts, and alignment with target audience expectations.
 About You
 The essentials:
 5+ years of experience in a Creative Designer, Brand Designer, or similar visual design role with a strong portfolio showcasing brand-focused work across diverse media.
 Proven proficiency and day-to-day expertise with Figma.
 Solid foundation in modern design principles, including typography, color theory, layout composition, conceptualization, and modern web design standards.
 Strong track record of designing high-converting assets for digital marketing, social media, and interactive web experiences.
 Demonstrated ability to self-manage, prioritize deliverables, and thrive both autonomously and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
 Strong English communication skills (B2+ or fluent) to effectively present design rationale and interact professionally with global teams and stakeholders.
 Not a Must But a Plus
 Practical familiarity or active experimentation with generative AI tools applied to creative workflows and digital interfaces.
 Experience collaborating closely with UI/UX or product design workflows.
 Familiarity with motion graphics or micro-interaction design (e.g., After Effects, Lottie).

We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds who are excited to contribute to our mission.
 About Monks
 Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.

It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.
We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. **Job Title**

Associate UX Design

**About Your Business Area/Department**
---------------------------------------

Amadeus is at the forefront of improving the traveler experience. The Airport Companion App is a major contributor to this improvement. It provides a mobile solution to roaming agents at the airport. Agents equipped with mobile devices (such as iPads) can serve the travelers wherever they are in the airport, reducing the need to use physical desks. Initially designed for iPad (Apple) users only, we have just started an exciting transformation to support more devices and platforms (e.g., Android) and increase adoption among our airline customers.

**Summary of the role**
-----------------------

We are looking for an experienced UX/UI Designer to join our talented team in charge of building this app, based in Bogota office. You will work alongside UX/UI Experts and Designers, Software Development Engineers, Business Analysts and QA, using Agile methodology (Scrum and SAFe). You will work in a multicultural environment with colleagues based across the world in Dallas, and London.

As a UX/UI Designer, you’ll be accountable for the design of the product interfaces and flows based on solutions agreed with the stakeholders (Business Analysts, Product Managers, and the customer themselves).

**In this role you’ll**
-----------------------

* Create mobile user-interface designs considering usability/UX principles and mobile design best practices.

* Collaborate with customers and the project team to translate requirements into functional, user-friendly interfaces.

* Running idea and design workshops where necessary.

* Create wireframes and low fidelity mock-ups, drive the review and approval of those designs with both customer and internal stakeholders.

Blacksmith Agency
 Design
 Full time, your only job
 Remote (Latin America)
 About The Role
 Blacksmith Agency builds websites for clients across the US. As Senior UI Designer, Design Systems at Blacksmith, you build the Figma design systems our team ships every client site from: tokens, variables, modes and component libraries that developers build from without asking you questions.
This is a full-time, in-house seat on our team, and it has to be your only job. If you run freelance clients, a studio or agency side work, or plan to keep them, this role is not a fit.
 What You Will Own
 Token architecture in Figma: variables, modes and semantic naming, from primitives to semantic to component level.
 Component libraries that hold up across an entire site, not just a homepage.
 Handoff and documentation that let a developer or a build pipeline execute the system without questions.
 Several client brands at once, each distinct, with the same structure underneath.
 What You Bring
 4+ years as a product, UI or design systems designer, ideally on an in-house team.
 A design system you personally built in Figma with variables, modes and tokens, and can walk us through in detail.
 Experience handing a system to developers and keeping Figma and code in step.
 Strong spoken English. You will present and defend your system on live calls with a US team.
 Full-time availability overlapping US business hours.
 Not a fit if
 You freelance or run a studio and would keep clients alongside this job.
 Your work is mainly page layouts or marketing pages, without tokens or variables.
 How To Apply
 Apply in two minutes at the link, then take a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment with the same email. Qualified applicants then do a 20 minute recorded interview in English about the systems they have built.

vacantes.titulo: Senior Product Designer, Design Systems (Remote, Ibague)
vacantes.descripcion:
Blacksmith Agency
 Design
 Full time, your only job
 Remote (Latin America)
 About The Role
 Blacksmith Agency builds websites for clients across the US. As Senior Product Designer, Design Systems at Blacksmith, you build the Figma design systems our team ships every client site from: tokens, variables, modes and component libraries that developers build from without asking you questions.
This is a full-time, in-house seat on our team, and it has to be your only job. If you run freelance clients, a studio or agency side work, or plan to keep them, this role is not a fit.
 What You Will Own
 Token architecture in Figma: variables, modes and semantic naming, from primitives to semantic to component level.
 Component libraries that hold up across an entire site, not just a homepage.
 Handoff and documentation that let a developer or a build pipeline execute the system without questions.
 Several client brands at once, each distinct, with the same structure underneath.
 What You Bring
 4+ years as a product, UI or design systems designer, ideally on an in-house team.
 A design system you personally built in Figma with variables, modes and tokens, and can walk us through in detail.
 Experience handing a system to developers and keeping Figma and code in step.
 Strong spoken English. You will present and defend your system on live calls with a US team.
 Full-time availability overlapping US business hours.
 Not a fit if
 You freelance or run a studio and would keep clients alongside this job.
 Your work is mainly page layouts or marketing pages, without tokens or variables.
 How To Apply
 Apply in two minutes at the link, then take a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment with the same email. Qualified applicants then do a 20 minute recorded interview in English about the systems they have built.

Descripción de la empresa
Since 1926, at Publicis Groupe, we have evolved to become the largest and most valuable communications group in the world, where creativity and transformation are not only celebrated but also enhanced daily. Today, we are more than just a company; we are a connected platform operating under the philosophy of #ThePowerOfOne, combining efficiency and innovation in a model that seeks to provide our clients with borderless access to the best of every service. In an era of convergence and empowerment, we are excited to attract passionate individuals to guide our clients in their transformation, helping them reinvent and thrive amidst digital disruption!
Descripción del puesto
The Creative Designer (CD) is a skilled and detail-oriented individual responsible for efficiently managing various production tasks, and providing essential graphic support to various projects, primarily in the digital domain with 1-3 years of experience.
They develop refined designs based on feedback, involving creating master layouts, 2D/3D image compositing, and campaign adaptations using design software. Working independently and methodically to assume ownership of a project, the Creative Designer uses various applications (Photoshop/Illustrator/After Effects) and is comfortable with printing/CGI & video production steps and processes. Responsibilities include layout, adaptation, and final delivery of visually appealing pieces tailored to suit different media platforms. The CD collaborates closely with the creative team to ensure all deliverables are of high quality and align with brand guidelines.
Responsabilidades
 Collaborate with the creative team to develop aesthetically appealing designs for marketing
 campaigns, internet platforms, print materials, and other promotional materials.
 Assist with the creation and upkeep of brand guidelines to ensure brand consistency across all platforms and materials.
 Using design software and tools to create and alter graphic assets such as illustrations, icons, logos, and photographs.
 Produce sketches, storyboards, roughs, and mockups to visualize ideas.
 Adapt and resize assets for various media platforms and formats.
 Manage various production tasks, such as cleaning images, prepping files, and preparing assets for delivery, while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
 Participate in brainstorming sessions, contribute ideas, and participate creatively to build
 successful design solutions.
 Stay informed about industry trends, best practices, and production techniques through continuous learning.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as marketing, content, and development, to ensure that design concepts are consistent with project goals and objectives.
 Keep design assets organized and documented, including version control and archiving.
 Fast learner and apply best practices.
 Execute a variety of print and digital assets, including social media graphics, website designs, marketing collateral, and multimedia presentations.
 Manage and delegate responsibilities to other designers and provide directions.
 Share ideas in collaboration with other members of the creative team.
 Establish visual tone, character, and messages that will effectively connect with the target audience and fulfill the project objectives.
 Cooperate with the rest of the creative team.
 Present completed ideas to clients and team members.
 Stay on top of all trends and maintain best practices.
 Cualificaciones
 A bachelor’s degree in graphic design, Visual Communication, or a closely related discipline is required.
 Within the field providing a solid foundation in design principles, typography, color theory, and design software.
 Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) or equivalent design tools.
 Familiarity with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Keynote, Figma.
 Thorough understanding of how visual elements and design choices impact communication. This includes effectively conveying messages, emotions, and brand identities through design, and ensuring that the intended audience receives the desired message.
 Creative designers must pay attention to even the smallest details in their designs. This includes ensuring proper alignment, consistency, and accuracy in elements such as text, graphics, and spacing.
 A portfolio that demonstrates an in-depth understanding of design principles, typography, layout, and originality.
 Creative designers often work in teams or collaborate with clients and other stakeholders. Strong communication skills are essential to understand project requirements, present design ideas effectively, and work collaboratively to achieve desired outcomes.
 Excellent detail-oriented skills, as well as the ability to prioritize assignments and meet deadlines.
 Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
 Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously
 while learning.
 A strong team player mindset, open to collaboration and continuous growth.
 Minimum B2 English level, detail-oriented, and a team player with strong communication and presentation skills.
 Información adicional
We have an artificial intelligence-based interaction and connection platform called Marcel, which includes e-learning tools like Udemy and LinkedIn Learning, with more than 30,000 courses on different topics where you can learn according to your interests. You can also connect with Publicis Groupe's more than 100,000 creative minds.
We offer benefits such as hybrid work, an employee fund, life insurance, and birthday leave. You also have the opportunity to apply for various global vacancies within the company and the possibility of working up to six weeks per year from another country where Publicis Groupe has a presence through the global Work Your World initiative.
LOVE THE DIFFERENCE
Publicis Groupe #ThePowerOfOne connects creativity and technology, celebrating #VivaLaDiferencia. We recognize and appreciate individual differences as strengths that enrich our teams and community. Diversity and inclusion are key to our success!

Sobre 30X  
 30X es la red ejecutiva más grande de Latinoamérica. Fundada por Andrés Bilbao y Dylan Rosemberg, reúne a los fundadores, CEOs y operadores que están construyendo las compañías más relevantes de la región. Es una escuela de negocios y plataforma educativa para fundadores, operadores y ejecutivos de alto nivel. Ofrecemos programas intensivos de gestión empresarial diseñados y enseñados por practitioners que han escalado empresas como Rappi, Truora y Frubana.
 Sobre el rol  
 Buscamos un diseñador/a de contenido social con criterio visual fuerte y velocidad alta, que usa IA generativa como parte del proceso para construir la identidad visual del contenido de 30X: carruseles que enseñan, historias que enganchan y piezas que se sienten de marca. No es un rol de piezas sueltas — construye sistema, consistencia y output sostenido semana a semana. Recibe un objetivo y propone una solución visual completa sin esperar instrucciones detalladas.
 Qué vas a hacer 
 Diseñar carruseles educativos para Instagram y LinkedIn con narrativa visual clara: jerarquía, ritmo, lectura y cierre
 Crear historias y piezas para social que refuercen el mensaje y la voz de 30X
 Construir templates y sistemas reutilizables para escalar la producción sin reinventar cada pieza
 Generar imágenes y assets con IA e integrarlos en piezas finales con consistencia de marca
 Trabajar en Figma con orden: componentes, estilos, librerías y handoff claro
 Iterar same-day con feedback e incorporar cambios sin fricción
 Must have 
 Experiencia entre 1 - 2 años trabajando con marcas, startups o medios con cadencia de contenido real (semanal o diario)
 Portafolio con carruseles que demuestren claridad, narrativa, jerarquía y consistencia visual de marca — no templates genéricos
 Criterio de marca aplicado a social: consistencia, estilo reconocible, decisión visual con intención
 Dominio de Figma (componentes, estilos, sistemas, librerías)
 Uso real de IA generativa (Midjourney, Adobe Firefly o similar) integrado al proceso con criterio de marca — no outputs crudos
 Velocidad con estándar: entrega rápido, itera sin ego y no se bloquea esperando instrucciones
 Obsesión por el detalle: consistencia, alineaciones, tipografía, ritmo y acabado impecable
 Qué ofrecemos 
 Salario en USD
 Acceso a cursos y programas de 30X

Company Description
 We are Software Mind, an awesome team of engineers who are ready to ramp up any top-notch company’s projects! Our aim? To always be one step ahead. Become part of a multicultural company in constant growth with an excellent work environment certified by Great Place To Work!
 Job Description
 Position – how you’ll contribute
 Design end-to-end multi-step workflows (quizzes, questionnaires, guided finders, eligibility and matching flows) that feel simple and engaging, even when the underlying logic is complex.
 Design personalized recommendation experiences that present tailored results clearly, build trust, and help members make confident decisions.
 Design monetized components (recommendation cards, product modules, offers, and calls to action) that can be injected into AI/LLM experiences such as chat interfaces and AI-generated responses, balancing usefulness to the member with business goals.
 Map out user flows, branching logic, edge cases, and error or empty states, thinking through what happens at every step of the member's journey.
 Create mockups, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma that can be shared with stakeholders and partners for feedback and approval.
 Collaborate closely with the Product Manager to align on vision, priorities, and design needs, taking ideas and running with them to turn them into polished, high-quality designs.
 Partner with engineers, data/personalization teams, and business stakeholders, delivering precise specifications that engineering can easily implement.
 Incorporate business logic and performance goals (conversion, completion rate, drop-off, engagement) into design decisions, and iterate based on data and feedback.
 Qualifications
 Strong Product Design / UX Design experience with a product-first mindset, plus strong UI and visual design skills.
 Proven experience designing multi-step workflows or guided experiences such as onboarding flows, configurators, quizzes, applications, or decision tools.
 Experience designing personalized or recommendation-driven experiences, where content or results change based on user inputs or data.
 Interest in, or experience with, designing for AI/LLM experiences, such as conversational interfaces, AI-assisted tools, or components that appear within AI-generated content.
 Expertise in modern, accessible design, with a solid understanding of accessibility standards.
 Visual design skills that elevate designs into something delightful, with a "show, don't tell" approach.
 Strong background working with and establishing design systems that create consistency across experiences and applications.
 Comfortable in lean, fast-paced startup environments, iterating rapidly with limited guidance.
 Additional Information
 Nice-to-have Requirements
 Experience working on websites or apps promoting financial products.
 Experience designing lead-generation, affiliate, or other monetized experiences.
 Experience with experimentation and A/B testing for flow optimization.
 Experience optimizing UX for SEO performance.
 Familiarity with how LLM products surface content, sources, or sponsored results.

Guided by a **Human First** philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world's leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. **Archetype Designer**
======================

 Tech Skills

 Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Digital Design, UX/UI, or a related field.
 Proficiency in English at a bilingual conversational level is a MUST-HAVE. All work is carried out alongside a global team of marketing professionals across several countries.
 6+ years of experience in graphic and digital design, with a strong focus on web-based environments.

 A strong portfolio that showcases creativity, attention to detail, design thinking, excellent graphic quality and a wide range of design styles.

vacantes.titulo: Diseñador de Procesos (Remoto)(KTO en Gobierno de Datos) K1126
vacantes.descripcion:
Descripción del Cargo:
 En Keppri buscamos un Diseñador de Procesos con enfoque en Gobierno de Datos e Información para levantar, diseñar, documentar e implementar los procesos del modelo operativo de Gobierno de la Información en el sector financiero. Trabajará con Negocio, Tecnología, Ingeniería de Datos, Riesgo, Cumplimiento y Seguridad para que los procesos sean claros, controlados, medibles y aplicables desde un piloto hasta su escalamiento a otros dominios de datos.
 Conocimiento en:
 Arquitectura y diseño de procesos orientados a datos: levantamiento As-Is, diseño To-Be y modelado en BPMN 2.0 o notación equivalente (Bizagi, Visio u otras).
 Gobierno de datos e información: marcos de referencia como DAMA-DMBOK, roles de Data Owner, Data Steward y Data Custodian, dominios y subdominios de datos.
 Gestión de calidad de datos, incidentes de datos, metadatos (negocio, técnicos y operativos), linaje y ciclo de vida del dato.
 Gestión de acceso a datos, intercambio de información, gestión de cambios sobre datos y estructuras, y gestión de excepciones.
 Diseño de controles preventivos, detectivos y correctivos, matrices RACI, SLA, reglas de escalamiento e indicadores de cumplimiento, desempeño y riesgo.
 Gestión y conservación de evidencias y trazabilidad entre procesos, roles, controles, riesgos e indicadores.
 Responsabilidades:
 Inventariar y levantar los procesos actuales de Gobierno de la Información con responsables funcionales y técnicos, identificando actividades manuales, reprocesos, duplicidades, dependencias, riesgos y ausencia de controles.
 Diseñar los procesos objetivo del modelo operativo: fuentes canónicas, calidad de datos, incidentes de datos (incluyendo dominios compartidos), metadatos, linaje, acceso a datos, ciclo de vida del dato, evidencias, intercambio de información, cambios sobre datos, dominios y subdominios, excepciones y monitoreo y reporte.
 Documentar cada proceso: objetivo, alcance, entradas, salidas, responsables, sistemas, actividades, puntos de decisión, reglas de negocio, controles, SLA, evidencias e indicadores.
 Diseñar formularios, registros, listas de verificación, matrices, plantillas, procedimientos e instructivos operativos.
 Facilitar talleres de validación con las áreas involucradas y resolver vacíos, duplicidades y conflictos de responsabilidad entre procesos.
 Preparar guías prácticas, flujos resumidos y material de consulta para Data Owners, Data Stewards y Data Custodians, y definir el control de versiones de los procesos.
 Acompañar el piloto en un dominio de datos, medir desviaciones y puntos de fricción, ajustar procesos y controles y entregar una versión estabilizada y reutilizable.
 Definir el modelo operativo de la reportería legal y regulatoria de entidades offshore como base para la adopción de herramientas de consolidación y reporte.
 Educación y Experiencia:
 Profesional en Ingeniería Industrial, de Sistemas, Administración o carreras afines.
 Más de 5 años de experiencia comprobada en diseño y optimización de procesos.
 Experiencia demostrable en proyectos de gobierno de datos, calidad de datos o gestión de información.
 Deseable: experiencia en el sector financiero, reportería regulatoria y herramientas de catálogo o gobierno de datos (Collibra, Informatica, Purview, Alation u otras).
 Deseable: certificación DAMA CDMP, BPM o afines.

Job Description
 Join Publicis Sapient as a UX/UI Designer to craft impactful digital experiences for a major multinational tobacco industry client .
This role focuses on designing for direct-to-consumer (D2C) digital ecosystems — blending creativity, data insights, and usability to optimize customer journeys. You’ll collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and be assigned to one of two areas:
 Top of Funnel: pages that attract and engage new visitors — homepages, landing pages, campaigns, and discovery experiences.
 Bottom of Funnel: paths that convert visitors — product pages, forms, checkout flows, and account experiences.
 Your Impact
 Design website updates, new pages, and layouts from brief to handover, across desktop and mobile.
 Map and enhance user journeys within your assigned funnel stage to fix drop-off points.
 Use analytics, user research, and A/B test data to inform design decisions.
 Produce wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity UI in Figma, extending design systems when needed.
 Collaborate closely with developers, strategists, copywriters, and product owners to deliver seamless experiences.
 Design to WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards, with SEO and performance in mind.
 Participate in design reviews, workshops, and client presentations; clearly communicate design rationale.
 Prototype ideas and support user testing in collaboration with optimization colleagues.
 Share early work, give and receive critique, and contribute to common design patterns.
 Qualifications
 Skills & Experience
 5+ years of experience in visual design, with a strong portfolio showcasing digital design work.
 Strong UX and UI craft — from information architecture and user flows to visual design and responsive layout.
 Fluency in Figma, including components, auto layout, and design system management.
 Experience collaborating with and presenting to clients or senior stakeholders.
 Understanding of how design impacts acquisition and conversion metrics.
 Working knowledge of accessibility principles (WCAG) and HTML/CSS feasibility.
 Prototyping skills and an analytical mindset suited for data-driven problem solving.
 Fluent written and spoken English.
 Comfortable working in the tobacco category.
 Set Yourself Apart With
 Agency or consultancy background.
 Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO), A/B testing, or experimentation tools.
 Design experience for CMS-driven or component-based websites.
 Skills in motion or interaction design.
 Comfort using AI-powered design tools to enhance creative output.
 Additional Information
 An inclusive workplace that promotes diversity and collaboration.
 Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities.
 Competitive compensation and benefits package.
 Flexibility to support work-life balance.
 Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family.
 Wellness program and employee assistance.
 As part of our dedication to an inclusive and diverse workforce, Publicis Sapient is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hiring@publicis.sapient.com
 Company Description
 Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

Job Description
 Cultural Care Au Pair is looking for a Visual & Multimedia Designe r to join our in-house Creative team. Based in our Bogotá office, the designer will be part of a global Creative team with colleagues in Zurich and Boston. This broad, hands-on role will create visual content for global marketing initiatives across digital, social and print, as well as edit short-form social videos.
You will turn creative briefs and day-to-day requests into engaging, on-brand visual content. The role includes creating and adapting campaign assets, paid and organic social content, presentations, print materials and other marketing touchpoints, as well as editing short-form videos and creating simple animations.
As part of the Creative team, you will work closely with colleagues in Zurich and Boston, as well as Marketing, Paid Media and Social, following the team’s creative direction, brand standards and processes.
 What You'll Do
 Design and deliver high-quality marketing assets across digital, paid and organic social, email, web, presentations, print and events. 
 Translate briefs, campaign objectives and day-to-day requests into engaging visual solutions that meet audience needs and business goals. 
 Support design execution and production, including adapting, resizing, localizing and updating existing creative across formats, channels and markets. 
 Create and develop visual assets for Au Pair audiences globally, while ensuring consistency with the Cultural Care brand and broader creative direction. 
 Edit short-form social videos using supplied footage, including selecting clips, pacing, captions, on-screen messaging, graphics, animations, music and platform-specific formats, while collaborating closely with the Video team. 
 Collaborate closely with designers and video colleagues in Zurich and Boston, and partner with AP Marketing, Paid Media and Social throughout the creative process. 
 Apply feedback accurately and efficiently while maintaining a high level of visual quality, attention to detail and brand consistency. 
 Manage multiple requests and deadlines, maintain organized working files and prepare final assets correctly for handover, publishing or production. 
 Stay current with visual, social and digital trends, platform requirements and emerging tools, including AI-supported creative workflows. 
 You might be a great fit for this role if:
 You are a versatile, hands-on designer with strong visual craft and a strong portfolio across different channels and formats. You enjoy developing new ideas as well as working efficiently on adaptations, production and day-to-day creative requests. 
 You understand how typography, layout, imagery and colour work together to create clear, engaging and on-brand communication for different audiences and platforms. 
 You are comfortable working across static design and video editing, collaborating with different teams and responding to creative direction and feedback. You are organised, curious and able to manage several projects in a fast-moving international environment. 
 Requirements
 Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Digital Media or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 Approximately 3–5 years of professional design experience within an agency, in-house Creative team or marketing environment. 
 A strong portfolio showing hands-on visual design and production work across print, digital and social channels, with examples of video or motion work where available. 
 Strong understanding of typography, layout, colour, imagery, composition and brand systems. 
 Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign, with working knowledge of Figma or similar collaborative design tools. 
 Experience editing short-form, mobile-first content for paid and organic social using Premiere Pro or similar software. After Effects, animation or motion graphics skills are a plus. 
 Experience using AI tools to support creative development, design production and content creation. 
 Strong organisational and communication skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple requests while collaborating across teams, locations and time zones. 
 Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Additional languages are considered an advantage. 
 Willingness and ability to travel within Latin America and internationally, as needed 
 Please note that only applicants with an accompanying portfolio will be considered.
 About The Team
 At Cultural Care Au Pair, we believe that cultural exchange has the power to make the world a more welcoming, understanding, and open place. As the largest and most experienced au pair organization in the world, we build global families by bringing together international visitors with American hosts—providing meaningful childcare for families, an unforgettable year in America for au pairs, and a culturally enriching experience for all. If you’re ready to expand your own horizons we invite you to be a part of our global team of problem-solvers, relationship-builders, and innovators. Join us as we continue to bring the world a little bit closer together, one family at a time.
Cultural Care Au Pair is associated with EF (Education First), the world leader in international education. At EF we believe that the world is better when people try to understand one another. Since 1965, we have brought millions of people to see new places, experience new cultures, and learn new things about the world and themselves. Our culturally immersive education programs—focused on language, travel, cultural exchange, and academics—create students of the world, and turn dreams into international opportunities.
An equal opportunity employer, Cultural Care Au Pair is committed to inclusion and belonging across race, ethnicity, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, parental status, experience and everything else that makes you, well…you.
Learn more about Cultural Care Au Pair: https://www.culturalcare.com/

Job Description

Mexicali, MX
Are you ready to help us make the future?
Honeywell Aerospace is seeking an early-career User Experience Designer interested in contributing to the definition and design of elegant, usable products, services, and offerings that improve the lives of our customers and end users while delivering business value.
Our work spans a diverse range of products, services, and technologies, which may include General Aviation, Business Aviation, Commercial and Military aircraft, avionics, Space, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS), Artificial Intelligence (AI), connected products, web and mobile applications, emerging technologies, and immersive experiences.
When you join Honeywell Aerospace, you become a member of the Honeywell User Experience (HUE) design team. You will collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional engineering teams to help define next-generation aerospace experiences across web, mobile, AI-enabled, and connected solutions.
As a User Experience Designer, you will report to the Sr Manager of User Experience Design and contribute to user research, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and implementation activities. In addition to applying user-centered design methodologies, this position requires the ability to develop and maintain front-end user interfaces using modern web technologies and frameworks. You will contribute throughout the product development lifecycle, from research and concept development through implementation. helping bridge the gap between design and engineering by creating production-ready user interfaces and interactive experiences.
 Responsibilities
 Participate in workshops and design sprints across multidisciplinary teams.
 Develop, enhance, and maintain front-end user interfaces and portals using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.
 Contribute to user-centered design initiatives across multiple projects.
 Collaborate with senior designers and stakeholders to improve customer experiences.
 Contribute to UX strategies aligned with business goals.
 Define user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma.
 Participate in user research, usability testing, and synthesis activities.
 Help define design requirements for connected experiences across products and services.
 Translate UX designs into reusable, production-ready front-end components while partnering closely with software engineering teams throughout implementation.
 Support design system documentation and reusable UI components.
 Contribute to the maintenance of design systems and design language standards.
 Stay current on UX trends, accessibility standards, and front-end technologies.
 Qualifications
 YOU MUST HAVE
 Bachelor's degree in a design-related field or equivalent professional experience.
 1–3 years of experience in User Experience Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, Service Design, or related disciplines.
 Experience designing web, applications, and/or mobile apps.
 Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and user flows using Figma.
 Working knowledge of Human-Centered Design principles.
 Familiarity with front-end frameworks and browser developer tools.
 Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript sufficient to build lightweight user interfaces,
 interactive prototypes and collaborate effectively with software engineers.
 Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
 Portfolio demonstrating UX thinking, design process, and problem-solving.
 Advanced English level.
 WE VALUE
 Knowledge of design thinking and UX methodologies.
 Experience developing or maintaining SharePoint sites, pages, or user experiences.
 Experience working in Agile and/or Scrum environments.
 Experience conducting user research and usability testing.
 Experience with journey mapping, service blueprinting, task flows, and information architecture.
 Ability to sketch concepts before moving to digital tools.
 Working knowledge of design systems.
 Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG).
 Excellent collaboration and continuous learning mindset.
 Portfolio demonstrating contribution to commercialized products.
 BONUS POINTS FOR
 Previous experience with SharePoint development or customization.
 Experience with SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Microsoft 365, or Power Platform is a plus.
 Experience supporting internal enterprise web applications.
 Experience with SaaS products or connected enterprise platforms.
 Experience in aerospace, aviation, or other highly regulated industries.
 10% Travel may be required for this role.
Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.
Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.
Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

Diseñador de Producto
 Sobre MAJORITY
 MAJORITY es una innovadora aplicación móvil de servicios financieros todo en uno que incluye una cuenta asegurada por la FDIC, una Visa® Prepaid card, transferencias y llamadas internacionales. Para migrantes, por migrantes.
 La migración global es una realidad del siglo XXI. Ya sea que las personas persigan sus sueños, el amor o nuevas experiencias, cada vez somos más los que buscamos nuevos entornos. Nuestro propósito en MAJORITY es empoderar a las personas increíbles, valientes y talentosos, y ayudarlos a alcanzar todas sus ambiciones.
 Creemos que todos merecen la misma oportunidad de prosperar. Nuestra misión es brindar a los migrantes las herramientas para salir adelante en su nuevo país.
 Somos un grupo diverso de personas de más de 40 países diferentes que colaboran diariamente y buscamos a otros impulsados por el mismo deseo de crear productos significativos que unan distancias culturales y geográficas.
 Sobre el Rol
Buscamos a un Diseñador de Producto para unirse a nuestro equipo y construir productos globales clave utilizados diariamente por nuestros usuarios: transferencias de dinero, pagos con tarjeta y momentos que generan confianza en un producto financiero. Trabajarás en colaboración con product managers, ingenieros y creativos, llevando funciones desde el planteamiento inicial del problema hasta una interfaz de usuario pulida y lanzada al mercado.
Este rol se enfocará principalmente en nuestros productos globales, como las experiencias de criptobilletera y tarjeta en Colombia y México.
Es ideal para profesionales del diseño con una curiosidad innata, que se sienten cómodos asumiendo la responsabilidad de una función de principio a fin, atraídos por la resolución de problemas y disfruten colaborar con equipos de datos, cumplimiento e ingeniería. Deben sentirse cómodos operando dentro de las limitaciones propias de la creación de productos financieros y tomando decisiones ágiles con la información disponible para salir al mercado rápidamente e iterar, en lugar de esperar una claridad perfecta desde el lanzamiento.
Responsabilidades
 Liderar el diseño de funciones desde la definición del problema hasta el lanzamiento, colaborando estrechamente con un product manager y un equipo de ingeniería.
 Traducir investigaciones, requisitos de producto y datos (por ejemplo, análisis de la tasa de abandono en el embudo) en flujos claros e interfaces de usuario de alta fidelidad.
 Diseñar dentro del sistema de diseño de MAJORITY y contribuir a él, creando componentes escalables, bien organizados y fáciles de expandir por otros diseñadores e ingenieros.
 Considerar casos límite y estados menos comunes (errores, estados vacíos, cargas, rutas de fallo) como una parte central del diseño, no como algo secundario.
 Colaborar con partes interesadas de cumplimiento, riesgo y operaciones para diseñar experiencias que cumplan con los requisitos regulatorios y de KYC sin comprometer la usabilidad.
 Crear prototipos y probar enfoques de diseño, iterando según la retroalimentación y los datos del producto, utilizando herramientas de IA como Claude como parte de tu flujo de trabajo de prototipado.
 Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con los ingenieros durante la implementación, proporcionando documentación de entrega detallada y bien organizada para que las especificaciones, estados y casos límite sean claros.
 Presentar el trabajo con claridad a partes interesadas multifuncionales, incorporar comentarios y articular con claridad las razones detrás de tus decisiones de diseño.
 Experiencia y Cualificaciones
 Más de 5 años de experiencia en diseño de producto, idealmente en productos de consumo o móviles, con un portafolio excepcional que demuestre pensamiento de producto y cuidado del detalle visual.
 Dominio profundo y práctico de Figma (variables, componentes, auto-layout y nomenclatura de capas disciplinada y organizada) con trayectoria en la creación de sistemas de componentes escalables y reutilizables.
 Gran destreza visual: atención meticulosa a los detalles y un alto estándar de acabado perfecto en la interfaz de usuario implementada.
 Facilidad para usar Claude (u herramientas de IA similares) para prototipar diseños, además de experiencia diseñando prompts (prompt engineering) para apoyar o automatizar partes de tu flujo de trabajo de diseño.
 Apertura genuina a incorporar la IA en el proceso de diseño, utilizándola para agilizar la exploración, el prototipado y las tareas repetitivas.
 Un portafolio que muestre la autoría completa de principio a fin: cómo planteas los problemas, exploras enfoques y llegas a soluciones lanzadas, no solo pantallas finales pulidas.
 Soltura en el uso de datos para orientar las decisiones de diseño: lectura del abandono en el embudo, segmentación de uso o hallazgos de investigación para convertirlos en dirección de diseño.
 Excelente capacidad de comunicación para explicar y defender los fundamentos del diseño ante ingenieros, product managers y otros colaboradores, así como de recibir comentarios para convertirlos en mejores decisiones de diseño.
 Empatía con las comunidades a las que sirve MAJORITY e interés genuino en diseñar para personas que construyen su vida financiera.
 Comodidad trabajando en entornos de habla inglesa.
 Deseable
 Experiencia diseñando productos financieros o productos en entornos globales complejos y regulados.
 Experiencia con productos financieros para inmigrantes, sectores no bancarizados o mercados emergentes.
 Familiaridad con flujos de pagos con tarjeta, depósitos o movimiento de dinero.
 Experiencia contribuyendo o evolucionando un sistema de diseño.
 Experiencia con Lokalize u otras herramientas equivalentes.

About Revun
 Revun is building a next-generation software platform designed to modernize how property owners, property managers, brokerages, maintenance providers, service professionals, and real estate organizations operate.
The platform combines CRM, leasing, maintenance, accounting, payments, communications, workflow automation, compliance, reporting, AI, integrations, and stakeholder portals into a single operating platform.
Our goal is not to build another collection of disconnected software tools. We are building an operational platform that simplifies complex business processes, reduces manual work, improves visibility, and helps organizations operate more efficiently.
The product is already underway, and we are now looking for a strong product designer who can help turn a complex platform into an intuitive, professional, scalable, and commercially ready user experience.
 About The Role
 Revun is hiring a Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) to lead the design of our web and mobile product experience.
This is not a graphic design role, and it is not a role focused only on creating attractive screens.
We are looking for someone who understands how to design real software products, including complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, dashboards, workflows, portals, mobile apps, and multi-user systems.
You will work closely with leadership, engineering, and product stakeholders to simplify complex workflows, improve usability, create scalable design systems, and help prepare the platform for commercial launch.
The successful candidate must be able to think through product flows, user journeys, permissions, edge cases, responsive layouts, information hierarchy, and design handoff — not just visual styling.
You should also be comfortable using AI tools to improve your design process, speed up research and ideation, organize complex requirements, generate UX copy, explore layout options, create user flows, and improve documentation while still applying your own product judgment.
How to Apply
Please submit your resume and portfolio for consideration.
Your portfolio should include examples of real product-design work, such as user flows, dashboards, complex interfaces, mobile screens, design systems, marketplace workflows, SaaS platforms, or similar product examples.
Candidates with only branding, landing pages, social media graphics, or marketing websites will not be the strongest fit for this role.
Qualified candidates will be invited to complete a pre-recorded video interview 24-48 hours after applying as the next step in the hiring process.
Key Responsibilities
 Design user-friendly web and mobile experiences for a complex SaaS and marketplace-style platform
 Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and developer-ready UI specifications
 Design workflows for multiple user types, including internal users, property owners, tenants, vendors, service providers, partners, and administrators
 Translate complex business processes into simple, intuitive product experiences
 Work closely with leadership and engineering to turn product vision into clear, usable, buildable designs
 Improve the overall information architecture, navigation, dashboard structure, forms, portals, workflows, and mobile experience
 Design and maintain scalable design systems, reusable components, UI patterns, and style standards
 Create clean, professional, modern, and consistent product interfaces
 Identify gaps, edge cases, confusing user flows, and areas where the product experience can be simplified
 Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are technically feasible and implemented accurately
 Review builds and provide design QA feedback before release
 Use AI tools responsibly to speed up research, ideation, UX writing, documentation, design exploration, and workflow development
 Validate AI-assisted design outputs through human judgment, user needs, business requirements, and product logic
 Support commercial launch readiness by ensuring the platform is easy to understand, easy to use, and visually consistent
 Required Experience
 6+ years of UX/UI, Product Design, or related digital product design experience
 Experience designing complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, CRM systems, workflow platforms, fintech products, operational dashboards, or other multi-role software products
 Strong experience designing both web and mobile product experiences
 Strong Figma skills, including components, Auto Layout, variants, design systems, prototyping, and developer handoff
 Experience designing dashboards, forms, tables, workflows, portals, user profiles, settings, notifications, and role-based user experiences
 Experience working directly with engineers and product stakeholders
 Strong understanding of user flows, information architecture, interaction design, usability, visual hierarchy, responsive design, and design systems
 Experience using AI tools to support design work, UX writing, research synthesis, user-flow creation, wireframing, prototyping, or product documentation
 Ability to explain design decisions clearly and connect them to user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility
 Strong attention to detail and ability to produce polished, developer-ready designs
 Strong written and spoken English
 Ability to work independently in a remote environment
 Strongly Preferred Experience
 Experience designing marketplace platforms or multi-sided products
 Experience with property technology, real estate platforms, maintenance platforms, field-service software, booking platforms, fintech, CRM systems, or enterprise workflow software
 Experience designing products with multiple user types and role-based permissions
 Experience designing payment, transaction, vendor, booking, service-request, or dashboard workflows
 Experience designing AI-powered product features or AI-assisted workflows
 Experience improving an existing product rather than only designing from scratch
 Experience working in startups or fast-moving product environments
 Experience with usability testing, product analytics, user research, or customer feedback loops
 Experience creating design systems from the ground up
 AI Expectations
We are looking for a designer who uses AI as a productivity tool, not as a substitute for product judgment.
 You Should Be Comfortable Using AI To Help With
 UX research organization
 User-flow exploration
 Wireframe ideation
 Interface-copy options
 Product requirement organization
 Edge-case discovery
 Design-system documentation
 Competitive research summaries
 Prototype concepts
 Usability-test summaries
 Design iteration
 However, you must still review, validate, and improve all AI-assisted work yourself. Final design decisions must be based on user needs, product logic, business goals, usability, accessibility, and technical feasibility.
The Person We Are Looking For
You are a true product thinker.
You do not just make screens look good — you understand how people actually use software.
You can take a complicated workflow and make it feel clear, simple, and logical.
You are comfortable designing for different types of users who each need different information, permissions, dashboards, and actions.
You think through edge cases, empty states, errors, mobile responsiveness, role-based access, data-heavy screens, and developer handoff.
You are confident working with engineers and leadership, and you can explain why a design decision matters.
You are also comfortable using AI to work faster, explore more options, and improve your process, while still owning the quality of the final product.
What Success Looks Like
 The platform becomes easier to understand and easier to use
 Core workflows are redesigned with clearer user journeys
 Web and mobile experiences become more consistent and polished
 Developers receive clear, complete, buildable design specifications
 The design system becomes scalable and reusable
 Product screens feel modern, professional, and commercially ready
 Users can complete important tasks with less confusion and fewer unnecessary steps
 AI is used responsibly to improve speed, quality, and documentation
 Design work directly supports product launch and long-term platform growth
 Compensation
 The monthly compensation range for this role is:
CAD $24,000–$36,000 annually
Final compensation will depend on experience, product-design depth, SaaS and marketplace experience, AI-assisted workflow capability, communication skills, and ability to work independently.

Se requiere un Diseñador de Modas para el cargo Analista de Abastecimiento con experiencia en el desarrollo de colecciones y productos que se alineen con las tendencias del mercado y los canales comerciales. El rol es fundamental para definir la oferta de productos, abarcando desde la investigación de tendencias, la selección de materiales y color, hasta la elaboración de fichas técnicas detalladas y el seguimiento de muestras y prototipos. Se busca un profesional que aporte visión estratégica al ciclo de vida del producto de moda, contribuyendo al éxito comercial y la identidad de marca. Este puesto es ideal para un *Diseñador de Producto de Moda* o *Diseñador Textil* que desee potenciar el *desarrollo de colecciones* y el *desarrollo de producto* en un entorno dinámico.
Responsabilidades:
Investigar y analizar tendencias de moda color y materiales para la creación de nuevas colecciones.
Desarrollar conceptos de diseño y productos innovadores alineados con la identidad de marca y el mercado.
Elaborar fichas técnicas detalladas para cada prenda o producto incluyendo especificaciones técnicas y de materiales.
Seleccionar y proponer materiales textiles y avíos adecuados para cada colección.
Supervisar y dar seguimiento al desarrollo de muestras y prototipos asegurando la calidad y el cumplimiento de las especificaciones.
Colaborar con equipos de producción y compras para garantizar la viabilidad y la correcta ejecución de los diseños.
Mantenerse actualizado sobre las novedades del sector de la moda el retail y la confección.
Requerimientos:
Experiencia mínima de 2 años en diseño de modas desarrollo de producto o roles afines.
Formación Tecnóloga o profesional en en carreras de Diseño, Moda, Administrativas, Ingenierías o áreas afines.
Dominio en investigación de tendencias de moda y análisis de mercado.
Capacidad demostrada en el desarrollo de colecciones y productos.
Experiencia en la elaboración y gestión de fichas técnicas.
Conocimiento en selección de materiales colorimetría y textiles.
Habilidad para el seguimiento de muestras y prototipos con proveedores.
Manejo de herramientas de diseño gráfico y de moda.
Nivel de educación:
Tecnólogo(a) o Profesional en carreras de Diseño, Moda, Administrativas, Ingenierías o áreas afines.
Horario: Lunes a Jueves de 7:30 a. m. a 5:30 p. m. Viernes de 7:30 a. m. a 1:30 p. m.
Salario: 3.490.000, contrato directo por la compañía. 
Contrato: Termino Indefinido

I. Funciones del cargo
 - Edición y optimización de materiales para páginas de producto**: Realizar la adaptación y mejora de páginas de detalle de producto (landing pages / fichas de producto de e-commerce) a partir de plantillas y materiales base en Figma proporcionados por el equipo.
 - Desarrollo de materiales visuales de marketing**: Generar imágenes principales de producto, banners promocionales, gráficos de beneficios y demás materiales de difusión para comercio electrónico, alineados con el estilo visual de las páginas de producto.
 II. Requisitos del cargo
 1. Habilidades técnicas obligatorias
 - Herramientas de diseño**
 - Dominio avanzado de Figma: capacidad para acceder, modificar y organizar materiales y componentes de diseño de forma eficiente, realizar ediciones rápidas de páginas y aplicar diseños adaptativos.
 - Dominio de herramientas de la suite Adobe, principalmente Photoshop.

vacantes.titulo: Senior DTC eCommerce UX/UI Designer - Remote LATAM
vacantes.descripcion:
WON is building the next generation of AI transformation for enterprise organizations. We are not another AI tools vendor. We build AI-native systems, combined with deep human judgment and category expertise, that fundamentally change how our clients operate, make decisions, and serve their customers. 
 Within that, our design practice works with premium DTC and ecommerce brands doing $50M to $500M+ in revenue: brands with strong products and strong followings that are still leaving growth on the table. We are not a “make it pretty” agency, and we are not another CRO shop running button tests. We combine deep behavioral insight with quantitative truth, then ship exceptional work fast, and we are building the AI-native systems that let us do it at a pace and scale traditional design teams cannot match.
 About the Role 
 WON’s design practice partners with premium DTC and ecommerce brands doing $50M to $500M+ in revenue to build high-converting, revenue-driving shopping experiences. We work with brands that have strong products and followings but are leaving growth on the table. 
 We are looking for a highly skilled UI/UX Designer who specializes in the ecommerce customer journey. We are not a “make it pretty” branding agency, nor are we a software development shop. We combine deep behavioral insight with quantitative truth to design acquisition funnels, PDPs, and growth creative that move the needle. 
 As a technology-forward team, we use AI-native systems (like Claude Design and Figma MCP) to eliminate tedious manual asset creation. Automation gives us speed; your taste and eCommerce expertise dictate what is actually good. You will report directly to our VP of Design and focus purely on high-conversion ecommerce funnels and revenue-driving consumer journeys. 
 What You’ll Own 
 The eCommerce Funnel: End-to-end execution of high-conversion shopping experiences, full customer journey redesigns, and high-performance growth creative. 
 The WON Design Standard: Delivering clean, premium, behavior-driven, and detail-obsessed ecommerce UI that ships fast. 
 AI-Assisted Production: Leveraging WON's AI-native workflows (Claude Design, Figma MCP) and UI component libraries to scale your variations, moving from concept to shippable eCommerce assets faster than a traditional agency.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design high-conversion storefronts, landing pages, and quizzes that feel premium and belong in the top 1% of DTC. 
 Optimize the full shopping journey: acquisition landing flows, collection architecture, PDP storytelling, cart/checkout, and retention UX. 
 Design growth creative: paid social landing pages, advertorials, product education, bundles, and upsell offer frameworks. 
 Build and maintain scalable UI kits and design libraries tailored for multi-brand ecommerce campaigns. 
 Present work with conviction, backed by session replays, cohort behavior, and voice-of-customer data. 
 Continuously evaluate your own workflow and flag manual production steps that our internal team can automate next.
 How Success Is Measured 
 Conversion rates, AOV, and funnel progression move measurably on the experiences you touch. 
 High-quality DTC design ships fast, with minimal time lost between concept and production. 
 Your scalable UI libraries and AI-assisted workflows reduce manual design work over time for the whole team.
 Must-Have: 
 5+ years in digital design (agency or in-house) with a strong, explicit focus on eCommerce / DTC. 
 A portfolio demonstrating modern, premium eCommerce UI/UX and landing pages (not template-driven, and not B2B dashboards). 
 Mastery of Figma and strong, sophisticated typography instincts. 
 Taste that holds up under scrutiny: you can articulate why a UI decision will convert, not just that it looks good. 
 Comfortable being measured by hard numbers (Conversion Rate, AOV) rather than purely subjective aesthetics. 
 Familiarity with AI design tools, or a genuine eagerness to adopt tools that automate repetitive asset generation.
 Nice-to-Have: 
 Experience designing for high-end consumer brands (beauty, apparel, wellness, premium food). 
 Deep familiarity with the Shopify ecosystem and its UX constraints/opportunities. 
 Track record of contributing to CRO programs that produced measurable performance gains.
 Who This Role is NOT For: 
 Dashboard & Web-App Builders: If your portfolio consists entirely of complex software interfaces, logged-in user states, and long-term feature iteration, this isn't the right fit. We are exclusively focused on consumer shopping funnels. 
 Endless Deliberators: If you prefer spending weeks debating edge cases before a screen sees the light of day, you’ll struggle here. We value deep insight, but prioritize getting high-quality work into production fast. 
 Traditionalists: If you prefer manual production methods and are resistant to using automation or AI tools to scale your design output, you won't enjoy our workflow.
 Why Join WON? 
 Build UI/UX experiences that directly drive revenue for major consumer brands. 
 Work at the intersection of premium design, behavioral insight, and modern automation. 
 Collaborate with a founder-led team with urgency, taste, and full access to the truth: session replays, cohort data, and customer insights. 
 If you want to become an elite operator-designer who builds work that changes brands and makes numbers move, we’d love to meet you.
